calls.title: Bank Jago Onboarding
calls.summary: GrowthBook’s Jake Heier demonstrated their open-source experimentation platform, covering feature flags and A/B testing with warehouse-native data access, Bayesian analysis, guardrail metrics, and multi-armed bandits. Bank Jago team members (Albert, Gilang, Lim, Renjie, Aravind, Adelwin) raised pain points around ID list scaling, review/approval workflows, scheduling, audit trails, and self-hosting requirements. Next steps include Jake sharing documentation on audit logs, safe rollouts, and self-host
